<div class="wrap">
<h1>Capex pulse</h1>
<p class="sub">Trailing-twelve-month capital expenditure from cash-flow statements already in the live capex-pulse feed. Intensity is capex / market cap when both exist. A blank cell is a missing tag, not zero. Click a header to sort. Nulls stay last.</p>
<div class="kpis" id="kpis"></div>
<input id="q" placeholder="filter ticker or sector" autocomplete="off">
<div id="board"><div class="loading">Loading /data/capex-pulse.json</div></div>
<div class="foot"><b>Built for:</b> seeing which issuers are raising or cutting cash capex, and how large that spend is versus market cap, without inventing a growth forecast.<br>
<b>Data:</b> /data/capex-pulse.json (rows[] with ticker, sector, capex_ttm_b, yoy_pct, mc_b, intensity_pct, asof; market; hyperscalers; fails; method).<br>
<b>Formulas as published by the feed:</b> TTM = last four quarterly |capitalExpenditure|; YoY vs prior four quarters; intensity = capex / market cap when both tagged.<br>
<b>Not:</b> a guidance parser, an ARR/NRR extract, or a purchase-commitment note. Research only.</div>
</div>
<script>
function esc(s){return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&","<":"<",">":">",'"':"""}[c];});}
function num(v){if(v==null||v==="")return null;var n=Number(v);return isFinite(n)?n:null;}
function fmtB(v){var n=num(v);return n==null?"":n.toFixed(2);}
function fmtPct(v){var n=num(v);if(n==null)return "";return (n>0?"+":"")+n.toFixed(1)+"%";}
function cls(v){var n=num(v);if(n==null)return "";return n>=0?"pos":"neg";}
var SORT="capex_ttm_b", DIR=-1, PACK=null, ROWS=[];
function cmp(a,b){
  var av=a[SORT], bv=b[SORT];
  if(av==null||av===""||av==="?") { if(bv==null||bv===""||bv==="?") return String(a.ticker||"").localeCompare(String(b.ticker||"")); return 1; }
  if(bv==null||bv===""||bv==="?") return -1;
  if(SORT==="capex_ttm_b"||SORT==="yoy_pct"||SORT==="intensity_pct"||SORT==="mc_b"){
    av=Number(av); bv=Number(bv);
    if(!isFinite(av)) return 1; if(!isFinite(bv)) return -1;
    return (av-bv)*DIR;
  }
  return String(av).localeCompare(String(bv))*DIR;
}
function th(k,lab,left){
  return '<th class="'+(left?"l ":"")+(SORT===k?"on":"")+'" data-k="'+k+'">'+lab+(SORT===k?(DIR<0?" \u2193":" \u2191"):"")+"</th>";
}
function paint(){
  var q=(document.getElementById("q").value||"").toUpperCase();
  var list=ROWS.filter(function(r){
    if(!q) return true;
    return (String(r.ticker||"")+" "+String(r.sector||"")).toUpperCase().indexOf(q)>=0;
  }).slice().sort(cmp);
  var h='<table><thead><tr>'+th("ticker","Ticker",1)+th("sector","Sector",1)+th("capex_ttm_b","Capex TTM $B",0)+th("yoy_pct","YoY",0)+th("intensity_pct","Intensity",0)+th("mc_b","Mkt cap $B",0)+th("asof","As of",1)+"</tr></thead><tbody>";
  list.forEach(function(r){
    var t=esc(r.ticker||"");
    h+="<tr><td class=l><a href=\"/ticker.html?symbol="+encodeURIComponent(r.ticker||"")+"\">"+t+"</a></td>";
    h+="<td class=l>"+esc(r.sector==="?"?"":r.sector)+"</td>";
    h+="<td>"+esc(fmtB(r.capex_ttm_b))+"</td>";
    h+='<td class="'+cls(r.yoy_pct)+'">'+esc(fmtPct(r.yoy_pct))+"</td>";
    h+="<td>"+esc(r.intensity_pct==null?"":Number(r.intensity_pct).toFixed(2)+"%")+"</td>";
    h+="<td>"+esc(fmtB(r.mc_b))+"</td>";
    h+="<td class=l>"+esc(r.asof||"")+"</td></tr>";
  });
  document.getElementById("board").innerHTML=h+"</tbody></table><p class=sub>"+list.length+" of "+ROWS.length+" names. Generated "+esc((PACK&&PACK.generated_at)||"")+". Click headers to sort. Blank is missing.</p>";
  document.querySelectorAll("#board th[data-k]").forEach(function(el){
    el.onclick=function(){var k=el.getAttribute("data-k"); if(SORT===k)DIR=-DIR; else {SORT=k; DIR=(k==="ticker"||k==="sector"||k==="asof")?1:-1;} paint();};
  });
}
(async function(){
  var d=null;
  try{var r=await fetch("/data/capex-pulse.json?t="+Date.now(),{cache:"no-store"}); if(r.ok)d=await r.json();}catch(e){}
  if(!d||!Array.isArray(d.rows)){document.getElementById("board").textContent="capex-pulse.json missing or has no rows[].";return;}
  PACK=d; ROWS=d.rows.slice();
  var m=d.market||{}, h=d.hyperscalers||{};
  document.getElementById("kpis").innerHTML=
    '<span class="chip"><b>'+(d.n!=null?d.n:ROWS.length)+"</b> names</span>"
    +'<span class="chip"><b>'+(m.capex_ttm_b!=null?Number(m.capex_ttm_b).toFixed(0):"")+"</b> universe TTM $B</span>"
    +'<span class="chip"><b>'+esc(fmtPct(m.yoy_pct))+"</b> universe YoY</span>"
    +'<span class="chip"><b>'+(h.total_ttm_b!=null?Number(h.total_ttm_b).toFixed(0):"")+"</b> hyperscaler TTM $B</span>"
    +'<span class="chip"><b>'+esc(fmtPct(h.yoy_pct))+"</b> hyperscaler YoY</span>"
    +'<span class="chip"><b>'+(d.fails!=null?d.fails:"")+"</b> feed fails</span>";
  document.getElementById("q").oninput=paint;
  paint();
})();
</script>
